title: The Crushing Weight of the Abyss
hook: Your body would collapse instantly if you entered the Mariana Trench.
script: Your body would be obliterated the second you entered the Mariana Trench. Down here, the weight of the ocean actually compresses the crystal structure of water. This creates a crushing abyss five percent denser than the surface. But what happens to your body without a submarine? The pressure hits 8 tons per square inch, instantly flattening your lungs. That is over 1,000 times the surface pressure, like balancing an elephant on your thumbnail. Yet, the Mariana snailfish thrives in this nightmare. They survive because their internal pressure perfectly matches the surrounding ocean. Even single-celled Xenophyophores grow twenty centimeters wide in this lethal dark. Send this to the friend who thinks the ocean is just water.
